title: Polite Universal Referral Request
body:
Hi {{referrer_name}},

I hope you're doing well. I came across a role at {{company}} that aligns with my background and interests. If you're open to it, I’d really appreciate a referral.

I've attached my resume for your reference.

Thanks a lot for your time!

Best regards,
{{your_name}}

Hi {{referrer_name}},

I’m interested in applying for a position at {{company}}. Would you be open to referring me?

Thanks in advance!

{{your_name}}
